world_org_meetings.title: Europe to press US on Ukraine peace and Iran at Paris G7 talks
world_org_meetings.description: G7 foreign ministers will revisit Russia’s war in Ukraine and the prospect of further US strikes on Iran when they meet in Paris. Washington has kept the option of new strikes open since Republicans lost the midterm elections. Rubio is due to attend both days, compared with one in March.

world_org_meetings.title: UK and EU agree draft deal to scrap Brexit red tape over food exports
world_org_meetings.description: The food deal, ahead of a UK-EU summit later this month, is the most significant part of the so-called Brexit reset agreed so far.

world_org_meetings.title: Secretary Rubio has a tough time getting officials at G20 on the same page
world_org_meetings.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is hosting the G20 foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta, with a focus on economic and security challenges.

world_org_meetings.title: EU diplomats object to G20 photo with Lavrov, prompting US cancellation
world_org_meetings.description: The meeting in Atlanta will go ahead as planned, ahead of a G20 leaders’ summit hosted by President Donald Trump at his Miami golf club in December.

world_org_meetings.title: G20 'family photo' cancelled after protests over presence of Russian minister
world_org_meetings.description: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband confronted his Russian counterpart at the meeting and accused his government of killing innocent civilians in Ukraine.

diplomatic_visits.title: Pope Leo criticises Milei’s austerity in Argentina, says growth must benefit all
diplomatic_visits.description: Pope Leo XIV arrived in Argentina on Sunday from Uruguay, where his tour began, facing calls to help bridge divisions after three years of austerity under President Javier Milei. The visit to Buenos Aires is the first by a pontiff to the late Pope Francis’ homeland in nearly four decades.

diplomatic_visits.title: Europe will take part in US-mediated Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, French FM says
diplomatic_visits.description: France will participate in the upcoming Abu Dhabi peace talks on ending the Ukraine war, Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said Sunday, adding that Europeans will be represented at the summit. The talks will take place under US mediation on Tuesday and Wednesday.

diplomatic_visits.title: Spain: Zelensky urges Latin America to help repair Ukraine's power grid
diplomatic_visits.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has appealed to Spain and Latin American countries for urgent help repairing Ukraine's damaged energy infrastructure. He also met King Felipe VI during the Ibero-American Summit in Madrid.

diplomatic_visits.title: 'I can't believe he is one of us' - inside Salah's life in Trabzon
diplomatic_visits.description: BBC Sport travels to Turkey to watch Mohamed Salah play for Trabzonspor and discover how the 'Egyptian King' is settling into life by the Black Sea.

diplomatic_visits.title: Milei and Sánchez exchange a cold greeting at Ibero-American Summit
diplomatic_visits.description: Argentine President Javier Milei and Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez exchanged a brief and frosty greeting at the Ibero-American Summit in Madrid on Wednesday. Their encounter comes two weeks after Milei called Sánchez an “unpresentable dictator”.

elections.title: 'Flat', 'tired', 'cynical': Unusually gloomy Kiwis deliver New Zealand's tightest election in years
elections.description: The national mood is low, and faith in politics even lower - with voters deserting the major parties at the polls.

elections.title: How the Democrats' midterm wave shows a path back to the presidency
elections.description: Democrats remain cautious about jumping to conclusions of what their midterm wins could mean for the next presidential election campaign. Still, the dramatic scale of the victory has some seeing a potential path back to the White House in 2028.

elections.title: Cornell faculty vote no confidence in university's leadership
elections.description: The faculty senate of Cornell University approved a resolution Friday declaring no confidence in the school's top leaders, a symbolic gesture reflecting deep discontent on campus in the wake of a former student's lawsuit saying she was gang raped at a fraternity party in 2024.

elections.title: New Zealand counts votes in razor-thin election after campaign centred on cost of living
elections.description: In New Zealand, people cast a party vote as well as an electorate vote in a general election. With their electorate vote, New Zealanders vote for a candidate to represent their local electorate in parliament. They also vote for the party they want to be in government.

elections.title: South Africa’s ANC suffers worst-ever local elections result
elections.description: South Africa's ANC has suffered its worst-ever local elections result, securing just 30% of the vote.
